title: Generalized Coordinate
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify 'x' as the generalized coordinate for the problem.

title: Lagrangian Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct Lagrangian expression in terms of 'x' and its velocity.

title: Equilibrium Position
description: Essential Criteria: The student must determine the equilibrium position as (0, 0).

title: Equation of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the correct equation for small oscillations about the equilibrium position.

title: Solution of Motion
description: Important Criteria: The student must provide the general solution for the motion of the particle.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student loses points for omitting factors or terms in the Lagrangian or equations of motion.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student loses points for incorrect signs in the equations derived.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency of units in the Lagrangian and equations.
